settings.heading: Fresh eggs, on your schedule.
settings.text: Get pasture-raised eggs from Spring Bottom Farm on a schedule that works for you. Choose weekly or every-other-week and never worry about running out of fresh eggs.

settings.heading: Our family farm in Northern Baltimore County.
settings.text: Spring Bottom Farm is our family farm in Freeland, Maryland. We raise cattle and chickens, grow seasonal produce, and make fresh farm goods for our neighbors and local community.

settings.heading: Visit the Farm Stand
settings.text: Our self-serve farm stand is open 24/7. Stop by anytime for pasture-raised eggs, seasonal produce, firewood, Italian ice, flowers, and other farm goods.

settings.heading: Already a subscriber?
settings.text: Manage your egg subscription anytime. Skip a delivery, pause your subscription, update your schedule, or make changes to your account.
